g.text: Does longer audio predict higher accuracy?
Compare the raw association with an analysis controlling dataset and reference emotion.
Intervals cluster by dataset. Gemma has one dataset and no across-dataset interval.
Positive = accuracy rises with duration; negative = it falls. These are observational associations.
Balanced estimates give equal weight to each dataset and to each gold class within it.
